description: The graph illustrates the training loss over time for two methods—Vanilla and another method (represented by the red line)—as a function of training time in seconds. The x-axis, labeled "Training Time (s)," ranges from 0 to 250,000 seconds with major tick marks at intervals of 50,000 seconds, and the y-axis, labeled "Loss," spans from 2.40 to 2.75, with major tick marks at intervals of 0.05. The Vanilla method is represented by a purple line with triangle markers, while the other method is shown by a red line with circular markers. Both lines exhibit a decreasing trend in loss as training time increases, starting from a loss of approximately 2.75 at the beginning of training and converging toward a final loss value near 2.50. The red line consistently maintains a lower loss than the purple line across the entire training period. A horizontal green dashed line at a loss of 2.50 is shown, and a vertical green dashed line at approximately 200,000 seconds indicates a point where the red line reaches this loss level. A green annotation "1.26×" is placed above the red line near this point, suggesting a 1.26 times speedup in reaching this loss threshold compared to the Vanilla method.
